import ctypes as c,sys,pathlib,json
lib=c.CDLL(sys.argv[1]); h=c.c_void_p(); statuses=[]
def call(name,*args):
    status=getattr(lib,name)(*args); statuses.append([name,status]); assert status==0,(name,status)
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]); file=str(p/'archive.wim').encode(); source=str(p/'source').encode()
call('wimlib_create_new_wim',2,c.byref(h))
call('wimlib_add_image',h,source,None,None,0)
call('wimlib_write',h,file,-1,0x1000,1);lib.wimlib_free(h)
call('wimlib_open_wim',file,0,c.byref(h))
call('wimlib_add_empty_image',h,None,None)
call('wimlib_overwrite',h,0x4900,1);lib.wimlib_free(h)
call('wimlib_open_wim',file,0,c.byref(h));call('wimlib_verify_wim',h,0);lib.wimlib_free(h)
print(json.dumps(statuses))
